action_contract.decision: per-joint argmax of learned logits; ties use first class
action_contract.HOLD: previous actually applied target; original runtime projection retained
action_contract.UPDATE: bounded previous-target increment for seven arms and eleven recovery fingers; other ten finger joints retain frozen V4 residual
action_contract.arm_bound_contract: 0.025 rad from unchanged original min(step_limit, command_velocity_limits * control_dt), independently verified against every dataset and actual environment

training_label_contract.comparison_space: original float32 action roundtrip and project_target
training_label_contract.BASE: expert projected target bitwise equals projected frozen V4 target
training_label_contract.HOLD: not BASE and expert projected target bitwise equals projected previous actual command
training_label_contract.UPDATE: neither exact branch and distance from BOTH projected branches exceeds 1e-6 rad
training_label_contract.ambiguous: neither exact branch and within 1e-6 rad of at least one projected branch
training_label_contract.ambiguous_continuous_regression: unmodified expert target assigned to UPDATE head regression
training_label_contract.continuous_regression: all original labels compared to label-selected projected branch; exact BASE/HOLD errors are zero by construction

classification_contract.comparison_space: original float32 action roundtrip and project_target
classification_contract.BASE: expert projected target bitwise equals projected frozen V4 target
classification_contract.HOLD: not BASE and expert projected target bitwise equals projected previous actual command
classification_contract.UPDATE: neither exact branch and distance from BOTH projected branches exceeds 1e-6 rad
classification_contract.ambiguous: neither exact branch and within 1e-6 rad of at least one projected branch
classification_contract.ambiguous_continuous_regression: unmodified expert target assigned to UPDATE head regression
classification_contract.continuous_regression: all original labels compared to label-selected projected branch; exact BASE/HOLD errors are zero by construction

selection_contract.candidate_boundary_check: CPU sequential actual prefix through step560

coverage_architecture_contract.BASE: frozen V4 proposal through original float32 action roundtrip and project_target
coverage_architecture_contract.HOLD: actual previous applied target through original float32 action roundtrip and project_target
coverage_architecture_contract.UPDATE_recovery11: actual previous applied target plus bounded 0.006 rad continuous delta
coverage_architecture_contract.UPDATE_arm7: previous actual target plus original per-step min cap 0.025 rad; original projector unchanged
coverage_architecture_contract.UPDATE_other10: frozen V4 proposal plus unchanged 1e-6 rad residual
coverage_architecture_contract.confident_UPDATE: float64 absolute distance from both projected BASE and projected HOLD strictly greater than 1e-6
coverage_architecture_contract.ambiguous: neither branch exact and within 1e-6 of at least one branch; excluded from classification only
